errors.description: channel_status_q is a multi-bit value produced in hbm_clk and sampled directly in noc_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
alert_pulse_q is a one-cycle hbm_clk pulse consumed directly in noc_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
alert_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample noc_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in noc_event_o.
stack_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector stack_mode_q before decoding in noc_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
hbm_rst_n is used as data inside noc_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines hbm_clk payload state with noc_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
